body:
I am on antidepressants mood stabiliser and ADHD meds. I cant stay asleep. Prescribed immovane for a week to try out. Made me groggish and slow all the next day. Made me feel restless and still had problem staying asleep.
It gets me to sleep after feeling dizzy and light headed but I dont black out as I'd like totally.
Ill try something else next week.
